proposals.change_target: make turnover legible through a waiting inventory and relative appetite growth
proposals.cause: The accepted field exchange was mechanically continuous but the lower panel provided no persistent source of incoming identities. The first inventory draft mixed waiting and collected states, shifted immediately, used absolute appetite assumptions, replayed collected cargo beside the dock, and seeded motion from a seventh off-grid slot, so it read as lag or a rendering error and scaled poorly across user activity levels.
proposals.candidate_change: Reuse the centre status merge for exactly six fixed waiting pens and the existing UFO glyph. Drive it only from visual dispatch times: leave opening holes before one group refill, then load the front sheep, hold one empty pen, and shift only the five visible in-grid sheep one slot per turnover before revealing the next sheep in the last pen. Keep the dock unboxed with no collected-sheep replay, and let collected energy remain on the accepted pickup and finale path. Decrease the count to zero, remove artificial bridge cells, and drop each incoming actor at its first bite. Rank weeks relative to the same user's active weeks, assign deterministic balanced appetite quotas, normalize fullness to each capacity, and reuse the existing growth track so every sheep starts at scale 1 while full high and low sheep end near a 1.20 ratio.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The renderer already owns sheep art, identity tags, the UFO symbol, exact spawn/hide times, bite energy, and growth keyframes. Reusing those paths requires no dependency, random state, second actor model, or new effect layer.
proposals.reproduction: Run npm run visual:fixture and npm run check; inspect native and 3x dark/light representative plus sparse/dense opening, turnover, growth, and terminal frames; verify inventory count and tag mapping, no collected replay or source slot outside 0..5, direct first-bite drops, appetite balance and scale ratio, reduced motion, camera/map/finale, selected opacity, and 30fps/120fps lifecycle continuity; require a fresh independent Gate.
proposals.primary_metric: At 700px every dispatch reads as one actual waiting sheep leaving a stable six-pen queue, while different user activity densities still produce a balanced appetite mix whose growth begins equally and ends with a visible but restrained 20% high/low size difference.
proposals.prediction: A waiting-only queue with explicit holes and one-step movement will communicate replacement more clearly than roster or text status, and per-user relative appetite will preserve large sheep for both heavy and casual contributors.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if waiting count rises or fails to end at zero; collected sheep rejoin; opening or turnover holes are not legible; queue motion resembles a jump or duplicate; appetite depends on absolute commit thresholds or randomness; sheep begin at different sizes; mature high/low ratio is not approximately 1.20; direct drops break lifecycle continuity; or accepted motion, camera, map, panel, theme, finale, size, and runtime checks regress.
proposals.regression_check: npm run check plus a fresh independent visual Gate over waiting-inventory lifecycle, relative appetite and growth, direct first-bite drops, dark/light sparse/representative/dense layouts, reduced motion, camera/map/meter, terminal, selected opacity, and 30fps/120fps continuity.
proposals.transfer_check: Not applicable; keep the inventory choreography and appetite calibration project-scoped.
guardrails: Waiting inventory contains undispatched sheep only and decreases monotonically to zero
Use the existing sheep, UFO, tag, bite, and growth systems; add no actor or effect layer
Every sheep starts at scale 1 and grows only from recorded bites
Use per-user relative activity with deterministic balance, never random or absolute thresholds
Keep the live camera, fixed map, ten-cell fullness, themes, and finale
Add no dependency and do not push without explicit approval
proposals.rollback: Restore accepted v49 without the waiting inventory, appetite tiers, or direct first-bite replacement drops.

promotions.before: The lower panel had no persistent source for incoming identities; its first waiting-inventory draft replayed collected sheep beside a cramped boxed dock and animated a seventh sheep from beyond the six-pen grid. Appetite also used absolute activity assumptions.
promotions.after: The centre panel contains only six fixed waiting pens and one unboxed UFO dock. Collected sheep remain on the field pickup and finale path, only the five visible in-grid occupants shift one adjacent pen, the next hidden sheep appears afterward in the last pen, and appetite is balanced relative to each user's active weeks with direct first-work-cell drops.

live_cycle.metric: Native light and 3x dark opening vacancy, refill, first-two and late turnover, reduced-motion, terminal, source-slot bounds, waiting count, relative appetite, growth ratio, direct drops, field-camera parity, map, fullness, themes, and finale
live_cycle.rollback_threshold: Roll back if a collected sheep appears beside or inside inventory; an actor shifts from outside slots 0..5; the first empty pen or adjacent shift disappears; inventory rises or fails to end at zero; the dock becomes boxed or cramped; appetite becomes absolute or random; initial sizes diverge; the mature high/low ratio leaves approximately 1.20; or accepted motion, camera, map, meter, panel, theme, finale, size, runtime, and continuity checks fail.
live_cycle.evidence: A fresh independent Gate scored v50 20/20 with no blocker. Source inspection found exactly six pens, all data-inventory-slot values within 0..5, five in-grid sheep in every shift group, no flock-inventory-return path, and an unboxed dock. Native light and 3x dark opening, refill, first-two and late-turnover frames show no right-edge ingress or collected-sheep replay; reduced motion and terminal remain coherent. Relative appetite retains deterministic 6 high / 1 normal / 3 low groups, capacities averaging 20, equal initial scale, and an approximately 1.20 mature high/low ratio. Direct first-work-cell drops and field/camera/map/fullness behavior remain intact. npm run visual:fixture, npm run check, and git diff --check pass; the fixture is 2,406,604 bytes and 48.838 seconds, 41.3% below the frozen baseline.
